# Vendored wheel

`jstyleson-0.0.2-py3-none-any.whl` is a dependency of `extruct`. On PyPI it is published only as source code, so every
clean install would have to build it. This wheel was built once from the unmodified PyPI source
(`jstyleson-0.0.2.tar.gz`) with setuptools 80.9.0, so `pip install -r requirements.txt` never needs to build anything.

- Project: https://github.com/linjackson78/jstyleson (author: linjackson)
- Licence: MIT (as declared in the package metadata)
